proposals.title: Lazy typed constructor enumeration with conservative partial physical-closure bounds
proposals.mechanism: A finite typed constructor catalog derives bindings/compositions instead of per-bundle recipes; size-first enumeration preserves a frozen structural order. Conservative abstract types/availability/unavoidable-new-column sets reject impossible partial branches before completion. Complete candidates use the same exact alias/emitter/closure gates as control. No quality feedback or learned cost model.
proposals.testable_prediction: For grammars with many necessarily invalid partial branches, fewer complete terms are examined to emit the same legal ordered prefix. Weak bounds/mostly legal grammars may make treatment slower. This is an enumeration prediction, not a usefulness/speed-on-real-data claim.
proposals.nearest_source_free_experiment: Implement final-check and early-pruning variants over <=8 leaves,<=5 constructors,<=7 nodes; exhaustively establish a small depth2 reference set/order. Check legal prefix equality and injected bad bounds using <=16 invented fixtures of<=32 events, including shared/distinct mask names, NULL/zero, window separators, repeats/peers, B aliases and type/availability errors. No actual source, SQL, model or API.
proposals.benefit_task1: Executable rules derive the next legal operation/composition/bundle with explicit human catalog and structural prior; test bounded automatic generation and failure attribution without claiming supervised selector superiority.
proposals.initial_bindings: Only declared current grains/actions/projections and24/168h windows; no hidden arithmetic, nested retrieval, new windows or unavailable fields

abstract_bound.ideal: MustNew(p)=intersection of NewCols(c) across all allowed completions c under fixed emitter/canonicalization
abstract_bound.implementation_requirement: Any conservative subset is sound; uncertainty remains permissive
abstract_bound.prune_rule: No type-valid completion, or lower bound on unavoidable new physical columns exceeds frozen cap
abstract_bound.critical_condition: Committed output leaves cannot be cancelled by later rewrites in this grammar; changing grammar requires new soundness proof
